failures.description: seed-memory ratchet run 3 segfaulted (rc139) at seed-local startup; known intermittent native crash
failures.evidence: Native exit 1 at b02d32ef9: scripts/measure-seed-memory.sh 5 0 0 --enforce-budget run 3 exited rc=139 (SIGSEGV) at os_peak=90MB node_peak=0MB, before any measurement; runs 1,2,4,5 ok (149-160MB, fidelity verified, budget respected). This is the documented intermittent seed-local startup segfault (memory seed-local-intermittent-segfault, first seen 2026-10-09: rc139 at the first Prisma read, rerun passed 5/5; not reproduced). The same gate passed 5/5 on 052ac6ce7 earlier today. The diff touches no seed, Prisma or memory-measurement code; native crash precedes any app logic.
